notes.title: v1.3.1 - Loadout, Powerups, Achievements, Bug Fixes, and General Improvements
notes.notes:
Reworked the loadout system. There are now 3 tiers of powerups and after tier 1, players are unable to combine multiple powerups within the same tier.
 If your existing loadouts contain conflicting powerups, they will be automatically removed.
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/981273807803256902/1131960197615726652/Loadout_tiers.png?width=1404&height=910
 Dynamic scroll speed should better accommodate fast typers.
 Achievements and their fun little icons (Thanks FreshFromTheGrave) have been added to the game. More to come.
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/981273807803256902/1131960198517502093/Achievements.png
 Added Siphon, Flip, and Reverse powerups.
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/981273807803256902/1131960198030954507/Siphon.png
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/981273807803256902/1131960198265831514/Reverse_and_Flip.png
 Updated scorekeeping ui.
 Updated powerup unlock levels and costs.
